text: Lowe's Companies, Inc. has been publicly held since 1961, and its common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol LOW.

source.name: Lowe's Companies, Inc. Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The Company was incorporated in North Carolina in 1952 and has been publicly held since 1961. The Company's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange - ticker symbol "LOW".
